import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Data provided as a string
data = """Person ID,Gender,Age,Occupation,Sleep Duration,Quality of Sleep,Physical Activity Level,Stress Level,BMI Category,Blood Pressure,Heart Rate,Daily Steps,Sleep Disorder

2,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
3,Male,28,Doctor,6.2,6,60,8,Normal,125/80,75,10000,
4,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
5,Male,28,Sales Representative,5.9,4,30,8,Obese,140/90,85,3000,Sleep Apnea
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(data))

# Fill NaN values in 'Sleep Disorder' column for better plotting
df['Sleep Disorder'] = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('No Disorder')

# Set up the matplotlib figure and axes for a 2x2 subplot layout
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Sleep Metrics and Disorders', fontsize=18)

# Plot 1: Distribution of Sleep Duration
sns.histplot(df['Sleep Duration'], kde=True, ax=axes[0, 0], bins=5, color='skyblue')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration', fontsize=14)

axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)

# Plot 2: Distribution of Quality of Sleep
sns.histplot(df['Quality of Sleep'], kde=True, ax=axes[0, 1], bins=3, color='lightcoral')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Distribution of Quality of Sleep', fontsize=14)
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)

# Plot 3: Sleep Duration by Sleep Disorder
sns.boxplot(x='Sleep Disorder', y='Sleep Duration', data=df, ax=axes[1, 0], palette='viridis')

axes[1, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration by Sleep Disorder', fontsize=14)
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)

# Plot 4: Quality of Sleep by Sleep Disorder

sns.swarmplot(x='Sleep Disorder', y='Quality of Sleep', data=df, ax=axes[1, 1], color='black', size=5) # Add individual data points

axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
